target.title: fix: retry Signal session init conflicts
target.body:
Fixes #100944

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Signal DM follow-up messages could be silently dropped when the debounce flush hit `reply session initialization conflicted` shortly after a previous reply completed.

This made the bot appear stuck to the Signal user even though the message had reached the gateway.

## Why This Change Was Made

Signal inbound debounce flushes now recognize reply-session initialization conflicts through the wrapped error graph and retry the same flush with bounded backoff. The retry is scoped to this specific optimistic-concurrency conflict and leaves ordinary dispatch failures on the existing error path.

The delay schedule mirrors the bounded retry shape already used by Telegram callback submit handling.

## User Impact

Signal DM users can send a follow-up shortly after a previous reply without losing the message to a transient reply-session initialization race.

If the conflict persists past the retry budget, the existing debounce error logging still reports the failure.

## Evidence

- `git diff --check`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/signal/src/monitor/event-handler.inbound-context.test.ts` (`48 passed`)
